params.1273: Cook some spiders on a stick.
params.1274: Acquire an arrow shaft or a skewer stick.
params.1275: You can make arrow shafts through your Fletching skill.
params.1276: Skewer sticks are made using a machete with a thatching spar (which you get from Tai Bwo Wannai cleanup).
params.1277: Use the shaft/stick with a spider carcass (kill a jungle spider).
params.1278: Cook the spider in an open fire.
